scope: Preserve explicitly accepted Linux manual PWM0 through persistence, actual private IPC/DeviceManager replay and full-group codec/commit/reapply. Legacy unconfigured0 remains unset. Necessary data contract before public group transfer.

contract.fan: Successful manual0 sets manual_zero=true; subsequent nonzero clears marker. Missing/false marker omitted from serialization and treated as legacy unset0. Nonzero legacy PWM still configured. Contradictory marker/nonzero rejected before durable replacement.
contract.pump: Known saved mcu/application source distinguishes explicit0 from empty-source unset0; legacy Application recognized at attach. Nonzero existing behavior retained. No new pump marker or periodic Fixed policy substitution.
contract.replay: Manager and group Apply share has_manual_setting predicates. Explicit0 emits normal cmd139/138 and retains pump MCU/motherboard source. Active cooling policy still overrides cached manual preference.
contract.compatibility: Missing marker preserves exact prior fan portable JSON shape, so old group hashing is not perturbed. Existing section literals in tests add Default only to retain legacy absent-marker semantics. Historical ambiguous fan0 is not guessed as explicit.
contract.scope_limit: Preservation/wire-value evidence only; actual PWM0/RPM/mechanical behavior requires deferred hardware acceptance. Public group IPC/CLI/GUI still pending.

regression.coverage: Four actual DeviceManager lifetimes/private IPC/MockBackend: unset0 no PWM startup -> explicit fan0 and pump motherboard0 -> restart -> pump MCU0 -> restart -> fan67 -> restart. Independent cmd139/138 histories verify source/duty0 and reported state; new nonzero clears fan marker. Legacy TOML/JSON fan0/64 shapes and bad-marker file protection. Actual group file codec/owner commit/Apply/reapply: explicit0 emits2 PWM writes, unset0 none, receipt-before-write and immutable device/profile bytes on reapply.

checks.ui: Source inspection only: Cooling.svelte applied_percent uses nullish coalescing and displays0. No native/browser GUI run.
checks.hardware: NOT RUN: user deferred; mock backends/private queues only
